def swap_List(lst):
    # Check if the list has at least two elements before swapping
    if len(lst) < 2:
        return lst
    
    # Swap the first (index 0) and last (-1) elements using tuple unpacking
    lst[0], lst[-1] = lst[-1], lst[0]
    
    return lst

# Test cases
assert swap_List([12, 35, 9, 56, 24]) == [24, 35, 9, 56, 12]
print("Test passed!")

# Additional test for edge case (single element)
result = swap_List([5])
assert result == [5], f"Expected [5], got {result}"
print(f"Single element test passed: {result}")

# Test with two elements
assert swap_List([1, 2]) == [2, 1]
print("Two-element list test passed!")

def swap_List(lst):
    # Check if the list has at least two elements before swapping
    if len(lst) < 2:
        return lst
    
    # Swap the first (index 0) and last (-1) elements using tuple unpacking
    lst[0], lst[-1] = lst[-1], lst[0]
    
    return lst

# Test cases
assert swap_List([12, 35, 9, 56, 24]) == [24, 35, 9, 56, 12]
print("Test passed!")

# Additional test for edge case (single element)
result = swap_List([5])
assert result == [5], f"Expected [5], got {result}"
print(f"Single element test passed: {result}")

# Test with two elements
assert swap_List([1, 2]) == [2, 1]
print("Two-element list test passed!")
